reference.conceptApproval: Not requested for this authorized development reuse prototype; final appearance not human-approved

materials.method: Original imported PBR / COLOR_0 and original embedded 256px grain/normal textures

collision.usage: Picking only; no implicit navigation obstacle
collision.sourceCoordinates: Blender metres Z-up. Resolve exported node world matrices for glTF Y-up.

stateRig.sourceCoordinates: Blender; runtime reads exported node matrices

gameplay.scope: First Demo level single nest only
gameplay.authoritativeState: domain ledger owns spawn/hp/death; asset animation emits no gameplay timer or extra entities
gameplay.pulse: visual-only: must not spawn on animation loop boundary
gameplay.destroy: Stop idle/pulse; play once and clamp. Domain death independently stops future nest waves; existing insects/garbage remain.
gameplay.particles: No particles, timer, extra roaches, reward entities or full-screen stain included

preview.scaleBasis: Longest projected alpha silhouette; labels and card padding excluded. Exact DIP at DPR=1 / 100% only.

integration.status: Production visual-state integration; development art pending human review
integration.runtimeScale: Use metre bounds to adapt display width; no change to logical difficulty or old actor units
integration.renderOnlyChildren: Mesh nodes; collision_selection is a non-rendering empty
integration.animationRuntime: Production CampaignRenderer owns an animated model instance. idle/pulse loops advance in render; destroy stops them, plays once, then hands the same corpse ID to the existing crowd/cleanup path.
integration.stateSource: Existing live nest ledger object and ecology.spawnRemaining <= authored pulse duration select pulse. Authoritative corpse transition/new nest-kill receipt selects destroy. Earlier collection removes the visual immediately. Initial saved corpses do not replay destruction.
